prompt: A logo artwork that merges an architectural drawing with fine-art painting: precise graphite drafting lines of a house elevation with dimension ticks and construction guides, flooded with loose translucent watercolour washes of signal red bleeding into blush and lilac, visible cold-press paper grain, the washes forming the house mark itself. The mark is a single simple house form with a gently pitched roof and an open doorway, soft rounded geometry, calm and premium. Colour palette strictly cloud white, pale concrete grey, graphite, warm signal red with soft blush pink and pale lilac transitions. Centered, iconic, balanced composition with generous negative space, square format, museum-quality craft, hyperdetailed real materials, soft diffused daylight. No other text, no watermark.
